name: Japan
sources: No per-nation sourcing note existed when this nation was first entered in init.rs; the table header recorded only "Transcribed-not-invented: approximate 1990 historical starting conditions". Figures are transcribed unchanged from that table and their origin was not documented at the time.
The one documented exception is the bubble: "Japan's bubble is at its peak on day one" — the Nikkei topped out on 29 December 1989.
